categories.title: 1. Official Catalogs — start here
categories.desc: Maintained by the platform vendors themselves. The safest first installs.

entries.desc: Anthropic's official public repository of Agent Skills — the source of truth for the skill format and reference implementations.
entries.verdict: Two straight weeks on trending and near 190K stars: agent skills are now a first-class, platform-blessed ecosystem.

entries.desc: Anthropic's official catalog of high-quality Claude Code plugins.
entries.verdict: The canonical starting point — curated, versioned, and growing weekly.

entries.desc: Open-source plugins for knowledge workers (docs, research, planning) in Claude Cowork.
entries.verdict: Best pick if your agent work is writing and analysis, not just code.

entries.desc: Cursor's plugin specification plus the official plugin set.
entries.verdict: Defines where the Cursor ecosystem is heading — worth watching even if you don't use Cursor.

entries.desc: Google's official Android engineering skills for coding agents.
entries.verdict: Signals that platform teams now ship agent skills as first-class developer tooling.

categories.title: 2. Engineering & Workflow
categories.desc: Skills that change how your agent writes, reviews, and ships code.

entries.desc: "Skills for Real Engineers" — composable engineering skills straight from a working expert's agent setup.
entries.verdict: The most-starred skills collection on GitHub. Battle-tested and pragmatic.

entries.desc: Production-grade engineering skills and workflows for AI coding agents.
entries.verdict: Strong on quality gates and review discipline; pairs well with any coding agent.

entries.desc: "Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room" — biases the agent toward less code.
entries.verdict: One idea, executed well. Genuinely reduces over-engineering in agent output.

entries.desc: A single CLAUDE.md distilled from Andrej Karpathy's notes on LLM coding pitfalls — drops straight into Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
entries.verdict: Two straight weeks on trending. One file, one idea, a quarter-million stars — the purest proof that prompt-as-product works.

entries.desc: Multi-phase security audits producing independently verified, machine-readable findings.
entries.verdict: Vendor-backed and rigorous; the serious option for pre-release security passes.

entries.desc: Editorial-quality diagram generation: 44 diagram types as self-contained HTML + SVG.
entries.verdict: Fixes the "Mermaid slop" problem. Great for architecture docs and blog figures.

entries.desc: Formats agent output to be action-first and readable — stops agents burying the answer.
entries.verdict: Silly name, real payoff. One of the highest signal-to-noise improvements you can install.

categories.title: 3. Knowledge & Research
categories.desc: Give your agent structured understanding of large codebases and domains.

entries.desc: A collection of agent skills focused on building great interfaces — UI craft, layout and interaction quality.
entries.verdict: Two straight weeks on trending. Small but sharp — the go-to pack when your agent's frontend output looks generic.

entries.desc: Turns codebases, docs, SQL schemas and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph — local AST parsing, no vector store.
entries.verdict: A different bet on codebase context: deterministic graph instead of embeddings. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.

entries.desc: 177 validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases — "turn any agent into an AI scientist".
entries.verdict: Proof that deep vertical skill packs work. The template for other domains to copy.

entries.desc: "Make all software agent-native" — exposes arbitrary CLI tools through an agent hub.
entries.verdict: Broad reach; ideal once your agent routine goes beyond coding tasks.

categories.title: 4. Memory & Context
categories.desc: The current infrastructure bottleneck: making agents remember.

entries.desc: Persistent context across sessions — captures, compresses and re-injects what your agent did.
entries.verdict: The most compatible memory layer: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode and more.

entries.desc: Long-term memory for coding agent CLIs, with handoff between different vendors' agents.
entries.verdict: The cross-vendor handoff angle is unique — useful if you switch agents mid-project.

entries.desc: Context-window optimization: sandboxes tool outputs, cutting context consumption by up to 98%.
entries.verdict: Directly attacks the token bill. High impact on long agent sessions.

categories.title: 5. Learn the Ecosystem
categories.desc: Guides that teach the mental model instead of shipping a skill.

entries.desc: Visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basics to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates.
entries.verdict: Best structured on-ramp if the skills ecosystem feels overwhelming.
